rules.name: recon-dup-13-after-deploy-v6
rules.sql: SELECT count(*) AS view_rows FROM opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT h.business_unit, h.builder_version, count(*) AS rows, count(DISTINCT h.settlement_date) AS days, count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.view_fx_nc_factor IS NULL) AS view_fx_null FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC') GROUP BY h.business_unit, h.builder_version ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT h.uuid::text AS row_id, h.business_unit, h.view_fx_nc_factor AS fx_nc_factor, h.view_actual_fx_nc_factor AS actual_fx_nc_factor FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC')

SELECT h.uuid::text AS row_id, h.business_unit, fx.fx_nc_factor, fx.actual_fx_nc_factor FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h LEFT JOIN opera.fx_nc_factor_view fx ON fx.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND fx.business_unit = h.business_unit AND fx.trade_id = h.source_trade_id WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC')

expect.reason: the tenant count of the view returns (it ran 10+ min before v6)
every published shape C row is filled (backfill or builder v5)
the stored fx factors equal fx_nc_factor_view, row for row
